answer: Require every new identity to lock a small time-bound stake before it can transact. Like a vine clinging to a wall, each account must put down roots it cannot cheaply lift: the stake unlocks only after a cooldown longer than any spam campaign lasts. A willow branch alone is cheap to snap, but a thousand locked stakes strain the attacker's capital. Watch the sparrow: track which vouchers cluster behind each account, so flood farms reveal themselves by their thin, unvouched roots and can be quarantined as one network.
